variants.headline: We and {{partner}} agree to exchange embassies
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} have agreed to exchange embassies. Each can now open a mission in the other's capital. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: An exchange of embassies with {{partner}}
body: Letters from the foreign office confirm that an exchange of embassies has been arranged with {{partner}}. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} A resident envoy in each capital will give both courts a direct channel for official business.

variants.headline: We agree to an embassy from {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has given {{partner}} permission to open an embassy in our capital. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: {{partner}} agrees to our embassy
body: {{partner}} has given our {{terms.civic.government}} permission to open an embassy in its capital. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: A research agreement with {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} have signed a research agreement. Both sides stand to benefit from the research they carry out while it lasts. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: We sell technology to {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has agreed to sell knowledge to {{partner}}. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} The agreement sets a price for learning our scholars already hold.

variants.headline: We and {{partner}} exchange technology
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} have exchanged technology. Both sides leave the table with something new to study. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: A technology gift from {{partner}}
body: {{partner}} has made our {{terms.civic.government}} a gift of knowledge. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} The gift adds to what our scholars can study.

variants.headline: A technology gift for {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has made {{partner}} a gift of knowledge. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} The gift carries our learning abroad without payment.

variants.headline: We sell maps to {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has agreed to sell maps to {{partner}}. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} The agreement puts copies of our survey work into their hands.

variants.headline: We and {{partner}} exchange maps
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} have exchanged maps. Each side has received a copy of the other's charts. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: A gift of maps from {{partner}}
body: {{partner}} has made our {{terms.civic.government}} a gift of maps. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} Our surveyors will add the charts to the national collection.

variants.headline: A gift of maps for {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has made {{partner}} a gift of maps. The terms read: {{dealTerms}} The charts leave our keeping without payment.

triggerSummary: We signed a deal with several distinct commitments. The package can contain terms from one or both sides.

variants.headline: A broad agreement with {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} have settled several matters in a single agreement. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: One document, several clauses with {{partner}}
body: The agreement between our {{terms.civic.government}} and {{partner}} gathers several commitments into a single document. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: The clauses agreed with {{partner}}
body: The foreign office has issued the terms of its agreement with {{partner}}. Several matters were settled under the same seal. {{dealTerms}}

variants.headline: A diplomatic deal with {{partner}}
body: Our {{terms.civic.government}} has concluded a diplomatic deal with {{partner}}. {{dealTerms}}
